name: zclass_find_node_recursive_by_name
description: zClass_Class::FindNodeRecursiveByName searches a zClass node tree by node name from the root through children in forward order.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja still reports a known sbb flag-generation limitation in the inlined strcmp-style comparison, but the source-level comparison and traversal contract are clear.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x447bc0 validates the null-node report path, root-name comparison, forward child traversal using listB/listCountB, recursive search, first-match return, and null return when no child matches.
The native smoke verifies null-root handling, root match, first child match among duplicate names, recursive grandchild match, and missing-name null result.
